rationale: Reuse the existing governed conditional co-payment certification runner, explicit publication-boundary authorization, deterministic publication decision, and authoritative publication gate for one already-reviewed Bajaj My Health Care v2 lab/radiology co-payment assertion. The adapter resolves only the historical bound_not_published state and carries certified component semantics into the structured publication contract without adding reasoning rules or product-level co-payment authority.
supersession_impact: No capability is superseded or replaced.
authority_impact: No new insurance, recommendation, policy-instance, option-selection, or claim-payment authority is introduced. Publication is bounded to one certified assertion and retains the certification limitation prohibiting policy-specific option selection and claim-payment decisions.
